name: xView3-SAR: Global Maritime Illegal Fishing Detection Benchmark
description: The xView3-SAR dataset was created by the Defence Innovation Unit (DIU) and Global Fishing Watch to combat Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated (IUU) fishing through automated machine learning on synthetic aperture radar (SAR). It comprises nearly 1,000 co-registered Sentinel-1 SAR scenes covering over 12 million km² of ocean surface, paired with bathymetry, wind speed, and sea state data. The dataset features ~150,000 verified vessel and maritime offshore infrastructure annotations correlated with Automatic Identification System (AIS) transponder broadcast data to detect vessels, estimate length, and identify dark targets operating with AIS disabled.
